name: Vid2Notes
tagline: Turn video and audio into illustrated notes with screenshots, timestamped chapters, and downloadable transcripts and subtitles.
description: Vid2Notes turns video into illustrated notes. Upload a video or audio file; it transcribes the speech, captures key frames as screenshots, and writes a structured summary with chapters and timestamps. Transcription is cross-checked against what is on screen to reduce errors. Export notes as Markdown or CSV, and download transcripts or subtitles (SRT, VTT). You can create 3 free notes every day, with no credit card required.
